## 📊 New charts on Home

- **By Merchant (30 days):** where your money goes, by shop. The top 5 merchants, everyone else as "Other", and spending without a merchant as its own slice. Names match ignoring case and extra spaces.
- **Income vs Spending (6 months):** income and spending side by side for each of the last 6 months.
- **This Month vs Last Month:** what you've spent so far this month, day by day, against last month, so you can see if you're ahead or behind.
- **By Weekday:** the average you spend on each day of the week over the last 12 weeks. The week starts on Saturday in Arabic.

On the desktop, the daily chart now spans the full width, with the other charts in pairs below it. All of it works in Arabic, right to left.

## Download
**Android**
- Also on **[F-Droid](https://f-droid.org/packages/ace.software.pocketsense/)**, which keeps it updated. It ships these same signed APKs, so you can switch between the two and keep your data.
- **`PocketSense-v2.2.9-arm64-v8a.apk`**: almost all modern Android phones. Use this one if unsure.
- `PocketSense-v2.2.9-armeabi-v7a.apk`: older 32-bit phones
- `PocketSense-v2.2.9-x86_64.apk`: emulators and Chromebooks

Installs as an update over any earlier version and keeps your data.

**Linux (x86_64)**: pick one.
- **Debian, Ubuntu, Mint:** `PocketSense-v2.2.9-linux-x64.deb`
  ```sh
  sudo apt install ./PocketSense-v2.2.9-linux-x64.deb
  ```
- **Fedora, openSUSE:** `PocketSense-v2.2.9-linux-x64.rpm`
  ```sh
  sudo dnf install ./PocketSense-v2.2.9-linux-x64.rpm   # or: sudo zypper install
  ```
- **Any distro:** `PocketSense-v2.2.9-linux-x64.AppImage`. Make it executable and run it.
- **Any distro:** `PocketSense-v2.2.9-linux-x64.tar.gz`. Unpack it and run `./PocketSense/pocket_sense`.

All need glibc 2.35 or newer and a running keyring (GNOME Keyring or KWallet). With the AppImage or the tarball you also need GTK 3, and `parecord` for voice entry (`pulseaudio-utils` on Debian/Ubuntu/Fedora, `libpulse` on Arch).
